articles.title: The 16GB Raspberry Pi 5 got another ‘unavoidable’ RAM price hike
articles.description: The Raspberry Pi 5 with 16GB of RAM now costs $385 after an $80 price hike, the latest in a string of increases driven by the ongoing RAM shortage. articles.title: SpaceX could buy Boost Mobile as part of its big mobile carrier plans
articles.description: SpaceX has discussed a deal with Boost Mobile to launch its own service through the budget-friendly carrier, according to a report from The Washington Post. articles.title: More European supermarkets are getting their freezers hacked
articles.description: Grocery stores across Europe have been hit by another wave of suspected cyberattacks, reporting sudden changes in the temperatures of their fridges and freezers. Major supermarket chains across Belgium, Sweden, Luxembourg, and Estonia were affected, according to local reports shared by Bloomberg and Reuters. articles.title: Jackery made its portable power stations even smaller
articles.description: Jackery announced a new portable power station that uses the safer and longer-lasting lithium iron phosphate (LFP) batteries the company first introduced in 2023.
